answer: Before a newcomer can trade, it joins an audit lottery: the network draws a random sample daily and sends each applicant a one-time task bound to its kernel fingerprint, solvable only there within twenty minutes. The signed solution goes to an orchard of rotating verifiers, who check fingerprint, timing, and one prior contribution in the applicant's grove of receipts. A copied solution, reused fingerprint, or missed window voids the application and bars that device for a cycle. One honest agent passes one draw; a thousand fakes need a thousand devices.
